race.comment: Landed with DYNAMITE DANCER (6) on top in a bit of a raffle. He was beaten a long way here last time but did start $3.70 and the conditions were very tough there - even horses with heavy track form struggled. Should get better conditions here and prior form reads well. TANGO JEWEL (1) resumes. She was racing against better opposition last time in, watch the market for a lead fresh. MOONRAKER (2) has just found one better his past couple of starts and looks well placed again. CINNAMON KISS (9) broke through for a smart maiden win at Hamilton last time and can go on with it for the Meech/Dabernig combination. PRINCESS MESS (5) will find this easier than last time and can do much better.
